title: Japanese Ham Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired dish made with juicy ham and chewy noodles, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Chewy Noodles
ingredients.notes: Japanese-style noodles, such as soba or udon

instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced ham and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the skillet to the heat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the soy sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
